articles.title: Gol de Lamine Yamal (0-1) en el Valencia 0-5 FC Barcelona

articles.title: Paige Bueckers left stunned by Zhang Ziyu’s towering height at FIBA World Cup
articles.summary: Paige Bueckers left many in awe during Team USA’s first game of the FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup, but her interaction with China’s Zhang Ziyu quickly became one of the most talked-about moments. The 7-foot-3 center towered over Bueckers, who couldn’t hide her surprise and even used her hand to emphasize the huge height difference. The moment caught FIBA’s attention too, as the organization shared photos of the pair, including a cartoon version, and jokingly asked Bueckers to “spill the conversation.” Ziyu seemed just as amused, leaning down to hear Bueckers better as the Wings guard appeared eager to get answers to her questions.
